MOVE below 80 is calm, 80-120 is moderate uncertainty, and 150+ is high stress; 100.36 is moderate. SOFR measures secured overnight funding, not unsecured bank funding. NFCI below zero indicates looser-than-average broad financial conditions; -0.487 is the latest returned weekly observation for Oct 23, not a live reading.

Fed & Policy Watch
  • The Federal Reserve Board calendar schedules no FOMC statement or decision this week; minutes from the Oct 27-28 meeting are due Wed Nov 18 at 2:00 PM ET. Its December calendar lists the Dec 8-9 meeting, a Dec 9 2:00 PM meeting item and 2:30 PM press conference.
  • Selected Fed statistical releases this week: H.15 Wed Nov 4 at 4:15 PM ET, H.4.1 Thu Nov 5 at 4:30 PM ET, and H.8 Fri Nov 6 at 4:15 PM ET; each date follows its own Board-calendar release-day list. The Chicago Fed schedules NFCI for Wed Nov 4 at 8:30 AM ET for the week ending Oct 30.
  • Latest funding/conditions readings are lagged: SOFR 3.95% effective Oct 30, NFCI -0.487 for the week ending Oct 23, MOVE 100.36 (moderate) and official 10-year Treasury close 4.91% on Nov 2. These are context indicators, not live funding or rate quotes.
Omissions and Watch
  • Date/event conflict check: the New York Fed calendar lists Advance International Trade in Goods and Trade balance together on Nov 4 at 8:30 AM. Census lists U.S. International Trade in Goods and Services for September on the same date and time; the exact title correspondence is unresolved, so both New York Fed names are retained with period not stated. Census lists today's Manufacturers' Shipments, Inventories and Orders for September at 10:00 AM, aligned with the New York Fed calendar.
  • BEA schedules GDP (Second Estimate) and Corporate Profits for Q3 2026 on Nov 25 at 8:30 AM and Personal Income and Outlays for October on Dec 2 at 8:30 AM. New York Fed also lists Personal Income and the PCE Deflator on Nov 25 at 8:30 AM without a period. That New York Fed entry is shown separately; it is not assumed to be the BEA Dec 2 release. New York Fed dates/times are tentative and subject to change. BLS.gov was not requested; New York Fed calendars are cited as the BLS release date/time source.
  • Energy schedule check: EIA petroleum's standard Wednesday schedule puts the report on Nov 4 at 10:30 AM; its Veterans Day exception is Thu Nov 12 at noon for the week ending Nov 6. EIA natural gas follows its standard Thursday 10:30 AM schedule on Nov 5 and lists a Veterans Day exception Fri Nov 13 at 10:30 AM. These are verified schedule-based dates.
  • TreasuryDirect verifies today's 6-week bill competitive bid close at 11:30 AM. Upcoming auction records with no competitive close time are omitted from the timed calendar. Routine statistical rows and non-material releases are omitted; this is a selected calendar, not exhaustive. No verified unscheduled policy/geopolitical watch item or exchange-specific market-structure event was identified in this run; this is not a full risk review. No exchange-specific hours were checked.
  • Sources checked: New York Fed November and December Economic Indicators Calendars; Federal Reserve Board November and December calendars, FOMC meeting calendar and H.4.1; Census 2026 Economic Indicator Calendar; BEA news schedule; Chicago Fed release calendar and NFCI observations; Philadelphia Fed MBOS calendar; TreasuryDirect; EIA petroleum and natural gas schedules; New York Fed SOFR; U.S. Treasury daily yield curve; Yahoo Finance charts. Reconfirm event/auction updates, market depth, product hours and selected contract before execution.
Trading Strategy Note | ES Futures
BASE CASE
The S&P proxy closed Monday down 0.48%, and ES=F is modestly below Monday's completed bar in the early Tuesday quote. The 10Y official close eased 3 bp to 4.91%; MOVE is 100.36 in the moderate-uncertainty band while VIX closed at 21.15. Today's 10:00 AM JOLTS and Census manufacturing release, then the 11:30 AM bill bid close, are scheduled catalysts. Wednesday-Friday add services data, energy reports, NFCI, claims and Friday's high-impact Employment Situation. Treat overnight price discovery as event-sensitive; wait for live rates, volatility and liquidity confirmation. Scenario framing only, not a trade signal.
INVALIDATION
Reassess if ES loses overnight support without confirmation from Treasury yields, volatility or market depth; if scheduled releases materially reprice rates; or if the chosen contract's hours or liquidity differ. No unsupported levels or targets are supplied. Verify contract, event updates and fresh quotes before execution.
